entities.name: Brallin
entities.description: Human shaman from Ikoria bonded with Shabraz.

entities.name: Shabraz
entities.description: Monstrous Shark Bird bonded with Brallin.

events.summary: Brallin attacks the flying shark Shabraz, intending a trophy.
events.quote: Brallin attacked the shark, who was surprised by the puny little human punching him really hard.

events.summary: After a long fight, Brallin and Shabraz bond.
events.quote: After a long fight, they ended up bonding with each other.

relations.quote: He is bonded with the monstrous Shark Bird Shabraz .
